notes.dataSourceId: Get from Notion API or database view settings
notes.defaultModel: Default Claude model (sonnet=best for most, opus=frontier analysis, haiku=fast). Override with: research_org: <url> --model opus
notes.reportLength: Not configured here. Per-section word budgets and validation bands live in references/section_guidelines.md, which is the single source of truth for report length.
notes.categories: Customize this list to match your Notion database's Category field options
notes.industries: Customize this list to match your Notion database's Industry field options
notes.compliance: Regulatory controls (HIPAA), compliance frameworks (SOC2), and 3rd-party accreditations the company holds. Customize to match your Notion database's Compliance field options.
